title: Reported Anduril Sparrows Point drone-boat facility talks
summary: Current reporting says Anduril is in advanced talks over a Sparrows Point drone-boat production/testing site, but no lease was signed and the reported memorandum of understanding has not been recovered as a primary record.

sources.title: Anduril Weighs Baltimore Shipyard Investment to Build Drone Boats
8 things to know:Defense firm eyes facility at Tradepoint Atlantic

data.claim: The Wall Street Journal reported that Anduril signed a memorandum of understanding with the operators of Tradepoint Atlantic's Sparrows Point yard and was in advanced discussions over a drone-boat manufacturing and testing site; no lease had been signed and the talks could still fail.

object.facility_purpose: unmanned surface vessel manufacturing and testing
object.agreement_stage: reported memorandum of understanding; no lease signed
